name: Troubled Mind
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of a troubled mind but directs believers to place their trust in God's unchanging counsel and Christ's peace. While human efforts and worries cannot add to one's stature or resolve inner turmoil, confessing sins and turning to God brings mercy and restoration. Jesus encourages believers not to let their hearts be troubled or afraid, promising a peace unlike that of the world and assuring them that through Him, they can overcome the tribulations of life.
